description:
FILED s534a (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08) with #4523 (same mechanism, same links; docs/method-lookup-eval-s534.md).  Prototype: the overload half of scratch/s534a/rt/proto-b.lisp in the s534a worktree (`%p-find-overload-cached`, `%p-find-overload-mro-rec`, `*p-overload-gen*`).

THE DESIGN: every handler p-find-overload can return comes out of `*p-overload-table*`, whose only writers are `p-register-overloads` (every `use overload`, `overload::import`, the `*{"P::(OP"}` stash spelling through `%p-glob-overload-entry`) and `%p-overload-unimport` -- each bumps `*p-overload-gen*` (a fixnum).  An entry (class, op) -> (handler or NIL, the generation, links) is valid when the generation is unchanged and every link's @ISA names equal its copy.  MISSES are cached too: `%p-conversion-derive` asks several keys (0+, "", bool, nomethod) for a class that declares only one, and each used to walk.  The cache mirrors the walk ORDER exactly -- which is breadth-first today, a silent wrong filed as #4522; fix #4522 in the same session or first (the recorder then follows the fixed order).

MEASURED: ovlbool (a `bool` two levels up) 0.5142 -> 0.1717 s (-66.6 %, PCL/perl 6.44x -> ~2.2x); ovlsub inside the control band (its handler is the class's own).  PPI overloads bool / "" / == on PPI::Element, so every `if ($token)` takes this path (3.5 % of the s534 PPI profile).

BAR: as #4523's (one batch can build both); plus the op/overload companion one-file legs (lib/overload.t, op/overload_integer.t) before/after, and a guard row per probe-matrix overload case (ovl-inherited, ovl-isa-edit, ovl-define-later, ovl-fallback-inherited, ovl-method-name) in the new method-cache-02.t.
subject: PERF (the overload half of the s534a recommendation): cache p-find-overload's answer -- handler or none -- per (class, op), validated by one generation (bumped by the overload table's two writers) plus the @ISA links of every class the walk expanded; drops the per-lookup `(cons cls op)` key too
